trait.name: Loathsome Limbs (4/Day)
entries: If the troll ends any turn {@status Bloodied|SRD52} and took 15+ Slashing damage during that turn, one of the troll's limbs is severed, falls into the troll's space, and becomes a {@creature Troll Limb|SRD52}. The limb acts immediately after the troll's turn. The troll has 1 {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} level for each missing limb, and it grows replacement limbs the next time it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The troll has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three Rend attacks.

bonus.name: Charge
entries: The troll moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} straight toward an enemy it can see.

entries.name: Troll

items.name: Habitat:
items.entry: {@filter Arctic|bestiary|environment=arctic}, {@filter Forest|bestiary|environment=forest}, {@filter Hill|bestiary|environment=hill}, {@filter Mountain|bestiary|environment=mountain}, {@filter Swamp|bestiary|environment=swamp}, {@filter Underdark|bestiary|environment=underdark}

entries: Trolls creep forth to prey on smaller creatures and drag captives back to festering lairs. These misshapen brutes can regenerate from wounds and regrow severed body parts—including their heads. A troll's severed limbs continue to move and attack. Unless they're burned by flames or acid, trolls can recover from egregious wounds and seek revenge on those who felled them.

Trolls typically hunt alone, but small groups occasionally cooperate to ambush prey or raid villages. Creatures such as hags and hill giants might convince trolls to work for them in exchange for disgusting meals.
